verdict.rationale: Grafana's own alerting engine runs in the background: alert rules are continuously evaluated and fire notifications, recording rules generate new data, and on-call escalates alerts automatically. The Knowledge Graph also continuously generates insights. These are fixed-purpose monitoring automations, though, not general user-defined or AI-agent automations that act on their own. missing for 10: general-purpose user-defined automation or workflow actions beyond alerting and notification, evidence of AI agents (Assistant/Investigations) running autonomously in the background, and independent hands-on corroboration of background automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Grafana will continuously evaluate and send notifications to systems like Slack, PagerDuty, VictorOps, OpsGenie.
create new data through the use of recording rules, and set up alerting rules
create on-call schedules, escalate alerts to the people who are on call
It continuously generates insights that highlight saturation, errors, anomalies, failures, and configuration changes
